conversation_lines.text: Sometimes, especially with confusion or weakness, the reflex isn’t strong. We’ll do a swallowing study to check.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: The swallowing study confirmed it. You’re silently aspirating thin liquids. That means you’re not coughing, but fluid is going into your lungs.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: So I can’t drink water?

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Not right now. We’ll thicken your liquids and may need to stop oral intake to protect your lungs.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We placed a PICC line so we can give antibiotics and fluids safely over the next few days.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: Will that help me get stronger?

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: It helps deliver treatment, but your myeloma is progressing. Your IgG level is very high, and we see plasma cells in your blood.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: The CT scan of your head shows no stroke or bleed. But your sinuses are inflamed, which could add to your fatigue.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: My head doesn’t hurt. Is it serious?

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Not life-threatening, but it’s one more thing your body is fighting. We’ll treat it if needed, but we’re focusing on comfort now.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your breathing is more labored. The chest CT shows possible aspiration pneumonia. We’re starting antibiotics just in case.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: I feel like I can’t catch my breath.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We’re giving oxygen and nebulizers. But because of your overall condition, we need to talk about goals of care.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your family and I spoke. We agree that comfort is the priority now. We’ll stop aggressive treatments and focus on keeping you pain-free.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: I just want to be peaceful. No more needles if possible.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We’ll minimize interventions. You’ll have morphine available for comfort, and your family can stay with you.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’re doing well with comfort care. Your breathing is slower, but you’re not in distress.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: Thank you… for being honest.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your mouth has some thrush, so we’re giving fluconazole. It’s common when the body is weak.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: It burns a little when I try to swallow.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We know. That’s why we’re not pushing food or drink. We’re using swabs to keep your mouth moist.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: The latest X-ray shows your lungs are stable. You’re still comfortable, and your family is here with you.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: That’s good. I want them close.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your breathing has slowed further. You’re peaceful, and we’re here with you every step.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: Tell my son… I love him.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: I will. He’s right here, holding your hand.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’re very quiet today. We’re keeping you comfortable with medication. Your family is by your side.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’re still breathing gently. We’ve dimmed the lights and let your family bring in music you like.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’re very close to the end. We’re not leaving you. Your family is saying their goodbyes.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your breathing has stopped. You passed peacefully, surrounded by your family. Thank you for letting us care for you.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We will notify the team and begin the process to honor your wishes.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your family is grieving, but they’re grateful for the time they had with you at the end.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We will ensure everything is handled with dignity and care.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You were brave and kind throughout this journey.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We will miss you, Mr. ___.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: The palliative care team will support your family in the coming days.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Thank you for trusting us with your care.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We will document everything with respect and compassion.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your legacy of strength will stay with us.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We will ensure your story is honored in our records.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your family has asked to spend a little more time with you.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We will give them privacy and support as they say goodbye.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: The chaplain is here if they need spiritual support.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We will assist with all next steps when they’re ready.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your journey has ended with dignity and love.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We will never forget the courage you showed.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Rest now, Mr. ___. You are at peace.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We will take care of everything from here.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your family’s love surrounded you until the very end.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We will support them as they begin to heal.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You were not alone. You were deeply loved.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We will carry your memory with us.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Thank you for allowing us to be part of your story.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your peace is now complete.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We will ensure your final wishes are honored.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your family will receive all the support they need.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You are now free from pain and suffering.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We will remember you with respect and gratitude.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your journey has come to a gentle close.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We will be here for your family every step of the way.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You were surrounded by love until your last breath.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We will honor your life and legacy.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Rest in peace, Mr. ___.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your story matters.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We will never forget you.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Thank you for the privilege of caring for you.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You are at peace now.
